verdict.rationale: Devin has a first-party Devin API with a documented API reference that lets you integrate Devin into applications and automate workflows. It covers programmatic session creation, including creating sessions on behalf of org users via create_as_user_id, and llms.txt lists an API documentation section. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Devin through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter
